A fresh update has just been released for our beloved office sim — check it out now! 

Version 1.15 adds a brand [b]new situation[/b] on the map that brings even more intrigue to your workdays. You’ll also find [b]2 fully animated scenes[/b] and 1 minigame waiting for you. 🔥 ːfuhrer_heartː

What happens if you use it? Who knows… but HR is already watching. 😳

Thanks a lot for playing and sticking with us 💖

notes.title: Furry Adventure Club and the Holy Grail🦁: Demo 0.1D Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3057290/extras/GifTop2.gif[/img]

We’re so excited to share version 0.1DB of our lighthearted adventure visual novel, [b]Furry Adventure Club and the Holy Grail🦁[/b]! This update is a big step forward as we work hard to get everything ready for the full release. Your support and feedback mean the world to us, and we’re thrilled to have you with us on this journey!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3057290/

Step into the paws of Indica Macjones as she takes her next big leap towards uncovering the legendary [b]Holy Grail[/b]! With this update, we’ve polished the gameplay, refreshed the interface, and worked hard to make every moment feel special. Along the way, you’ll explore mysterious locations, meet quirky and lovable [b]furry[/b] characters, and immerse yourself in a story we’re pouring our hearts into.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42902513/8870a6ac6f1c420c6e298d8f2366cb26114178be.png[/img]

🎮 [b]What’s new in version 0.1DB:[/b]
[list]
[*] A refreshed and intuitive interface to enhance your experience.
[*] Continued development of key story scenes and environments.
[*] Improved gameplay balance for smoother progression.
[*] Bug fixes and tweaks based on valuable community feedback.
[/list]

We deeply appreciate everyone who’s helping us refine the game by reporting bugs and sharing ideas in Discord and other social media platforms. Your support means the world to us and brings us closer to delivering a memorable adventure!

🔔 Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist and join our furry community! The adventure is just beginning—there's so much more to discover!
